note: Walkthrough fixtures. Every lot, buyer and pickup below is invented for the public demo and is stored in the browser only. It never touches the workspace store.

lots.conditionNote: Sample images show dry bales under a tarpaulin. No moisture reading was taken, so this stays a visual note.
Four days in the open, the outer layer looked damp in two of three photos. An inspector should confirm before an offer is agreed.
Quantity is a baler count estimate, not a weighbridge figure.

requirements.note: Runs a feed line that takes wheat straw; checks moisture on arrival.
Composting site, accepts mixed bales and inspects at the gate.

steps.title: Publish a residue lot
steps.body: Pick a simulated cell, set the quantity and storage, then publish the lot so buyers can see it.

steps.title: Match a requirement and send an offer
steps.body: Filter the open lots against a buyer requirement, read why each lot fits or does not, then send a simulated offer.

steps.title: Plan the pickup
steps.body: Turn the agreed order into a pickup plan and respect the vehicle capacity.

steps.title: Record what actually moved
steps.body: Enter the weighed quantity and the hand-over reference. The gap against the listing is the point of this step.

steps.title: Review status and data quality
steps.body: See the same flow from the programme side: which steps are done, what is missing, and what still needs a human decision.
